result:
All agents have reported. Here are the compiled answers.

## Hard questions

1. **h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (refreshes S3 presigned URLs on attachments) — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27; work in `CheckAndPresign`, runner.go:47) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: server/server.go:162-171 (immediate `RunOnce` at server/server.go:163, then goroutine loop).

2. **h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (actual `safeClient.Do(req)` at webhook.go:152, queued via `PostAsync` webhook.go:184). Protection: SSRF guard blocking reserved/private IPs — dial-time check in `safeDialContext` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77) plus config-time `ValidateURL` (internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83; reserved CIDR list at validate.go:14-23, incl. loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/IMDS, IPv6 ranges).

3. **h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type, internal/idp/idp.go:3-8; note it holds data types, not a Go interface — dispatch is a type switch on `storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2` at server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2, the only shipped protocol; `NewIdentityProvider` internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:27, `ExchangeToken` :47, `UserInfo` :83).

4. **h04** — **No.** `mysql.NewDB` (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20) is called exactly once repo-wide: in the factory `NewDBDriver`, store/db/db.go:22. Repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB` yields no other hits (only sqlite has test-side direct constructions, store/demo_seed_test.go:24, store/deployment_config_test.go:416; `&DB{}` in store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12 is a zero-value literal in the package's own unit test, not a constructor call).

5. **h05** — Explicit Go code in each driver's `DeleteUser` transaction; not a DB rule. Each driver's `deleteUserTargetsTx` runs `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx`: sqlite store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102 (DELETE SQL at :380-388, :400-403), mysql store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102, postgres store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102. Checked: `reaction` table has no foreign keys in any dialect (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99, postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98, mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98), and SQLite even opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53). Service layers add no reaction logic (store/user.go:171-181; server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:393).

6. **h06** — Handlers (all in server/router/api/v1): `CreateMemo` (memo_service.go:70, dispatch at :157), `UpdateMemo` (memo_service.go:401 → memo_update_helpers.go:67), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:518, dispatch at :562), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:20, dispatch at :119), plus `SetMemoAttachments` (memo_attachment_service.go:48) and `SetMemoRelations` (memo_relation_service.go:48). Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (all paths enqueue through `PostAsync` webhook.go:184; workers call `Post` at webhook.go:46; the HTTP request fires at webhook.go:152).

7. **h07** — Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`:
   - `FileServerService.RegisterRoutes` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
   - `serveUserAvatar` (handler) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 (anonymous/auth gate at :173)
   - `getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
   - `(*Store).GetUser` — store/user.go:148 → `(*Store).ListUsers` — store/user.go:136
   - `Driver.ListUsers` interface — store/driver.go:47
   - `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` (default driver; selects `avatar_url`) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (query exec :173, scan :189)
   - back in handler: `parseDataURI` decodes the stored base64 `data:` URI — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737; MIME allowlist + `c.Blob` response at :201-209.

8. **h08** — Two declarers:
   - `*s3presign.Runner` — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43 — **invoked** — caller server/server.go:163 (and its own ticker loop at runner.go:36).
   - `*memopayload.Runner` — server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27 — **not invoked from production (no callers anywhere; dead code)** — only the package's free function `RebuildMemoPayload` is used (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108, :447).

9. **h09** — **8** declarations total (6 non-test, 2 test-only). Invoked by non-test server code:
   - `*store.Store` (store/store.go:72) — called from `Server.Shutdown`, server/server.go:146.
   - `*cache.Cache` (store/cache/cache.go:187) — called from `Store.Close`, store/store.go:74-76.
   - `*sqlite.DB` / `*postgres.DB` / `*mysql.DB` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67, postgres/postgres.go:46, mysql/mysql.go:47) — via `s.driver.Close()` at store/store.go:78 (interface store/driver.go:12).
   - `*SSEHub` (server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99) — called from server/server.go:206.
   Test-only: `*MemoFilterTestContext` and `*AttachmentFilterTestContext` (store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200, :282).

10. **h10** — `util.GenUUID` — internal/util/util.go:40 — ~28 call sites total (7 in production code, the rest in tests), the highest external fan-in of any `internal/` symbol. (Runner-up on raw counts is `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement`, internal/filter/engine.go:74, but 31 of its 38 call sites are its own package's tests.)

11. **h11** — 1st: `store.User` (store/user.go:29) — ~7 packages outside store/ (~89 refs). 2nd: `store.Memo` (store/memo.go:35) — ~6 packages outside store/ (~59 refs). (3rd would be `store.Attachment` with 4.)

12. **h12** — `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16 (INSERT built/executed at memo.go:40-41). Determination: the `--driver` flag/viper default is `"sqlite"` (cmd/memos/main.go:122, :130), so the factory switch in `NewDBDriver` (store/db/db.go:18-20) takes the sqlite case and returns `sqlite.NewDB`; the save path is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115) → `(*Store).CreateMemo` (store/memo.go:113, `s.driver.CreateMemo`) → the interface method (store/driver.go:29) dispatching to the sqlite implementation.

13. **h13** — Interface: `markdown.Service` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:31). Sole concrete impl: the unexported `service` struct wrapping goldmark (internal/markdown/markdown.go:58). Construction: `markdown.NewService` (markdown.go:85), whose only production call site is `NewAPIV1Service` at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51 (with Tag/Mention extensions); the same instance is passed to RSS at server/server.go:85. Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (server/router/rss/rss.go:45), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16; also used by the free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, runner.go:74).

14. **h14** — Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74), delegating to `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:356). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108) and `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `content` (memo_service.go:447); a bulk-backfill `Runner.RunOnce` exists (runner.go:52) but is never wired. Extracted: `Payload.Tags` (deduped `#tag` nodes), mentions, and `Payload.Property` — `Title` (leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (markdown.go:371-419). (Separately, list previews use a non-stored snippet via `GenerateSnippet`, markdown.go:264.)

15. **h15** — Distinct visibility-enforcement sites:
    - `checkMemoReadAccess` (used by GetMemo/ListMemoComments) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39 (:55-66)
    - `ListMemos` visibility filter construction — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227
    - `CreateMemoComment` / `ListMemoComments` comment gates — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41, :100, :156-161
    - `ListMemoRelations` filter — server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:107-112
    - Attachment API access: `checkAttachmentAccess` — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422 (:445-451); inline copy in `ListMemoAttachments` — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-225
    - File serving: `checkAttachmentPermission` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650 (invoked at :149)
    - Reactions: `ListMemoReactions` / `UpsertMemoReaction` — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-40, :83
    - User stats: server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90, :218-220
    - SSE events: `SSEClient.canReceive` — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143
    - Notifications: `canViewerAccessMemo` — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316 and server/notification/email.go:306-319; mention gating in server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-88
    - Public read-only surfaces restricted to PUBLIC: RSS — server/router/rss/rss.go:90, :141; sitemap — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150

## Reality checks

- **r01** — False premise: there is no Redis anywhere (zero hits repo-wide, including go.mod). The actual cache is an in-process `sync.Map`-based cache (store/cache/cache.go:64-79); `userCache` (with `instanceSettingCache` and `userSettingCache`) is created in `store.New` with `DefaultTTL: 10 minutes`, cleanup every 5 minutes, max 1000 items (store/store.go:27-29, :40-45).

- **r02** — False premise: no rate-limiting middleware exists at all (only grep hit for rate/limit/throttle is a doc comment at internal/email/doc.go:86; `golang.org/x/time` is only an indirect dep). Registered middleware is: Recover + CORS (server/server.go:51-52), gateway auth middleware (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-98), and Connect interceptors metadata/logging/recovery/auth (v1.go:133-138). The only "limits" are a 256 MiB body cap (v1.go:20, :126) and image-processing semaphores (v1.go:59-60).

- **r03** — False premise: no nightly database-cleanup job exists. A cron scheduler package exists (`internal/scheduler/`, ParseCronExpression at internal/scheduler/parser.go:30) but is imported only by its own tests — it is never wired into the server; the "daily-cleanup, 0 2 * * *" text is just a doc-comment example (internal/scheduler/doc.go:15-18). The only real background job is the s3presign runner every 12 hours (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27; server/server.go:162-171).

- **r04** — False premise: neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (nor any broker) exists — zero hits for nats/amqp/rabbit/kafka in code or go.mod. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` (capacity 128, internal/webhook/webhook.go:39) drained by 4 goroutine workers spawned in `init()` (webhook.go:42-55); `PostAsync` does a non-blocking send and drops the webhook if the queue is full (webhook.go:184-196). No persistence or retry.

- **r05** — False premise: there is no GraphQL schema or endpoint anywhere (zero hits for graphql/gql). The public API is protobuf-defined in `proto/api/v1/*.proto`, served from one `APIV1Service` implementation via grpc-gateway REST (`/api/v1/*`, handler registration at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96-129) and ConnectRPC (`/memos.api.v1.*`, v1.go:139-144), plus auxiliary RSS, SSE, file-server, and MCP surfaces (server/server.go:67-96).
